title: Give notice of individual person with significant control of a limited liability partnership (LL PSC01)
text:
This form can be used to notify Companies House of an individual person with significant control (PSC) of a limited liability partnership (LLP).

 Use the online service to update your information as quickly as possible.

 It takes longer to process paper forms sent to us by post.

 PSCs must verify their identity and provide their Companies House personal code. The period for doing this depends on your situation. See  When you need to verify your identity for Companies House .

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
